decisions.reason: The firm has visibly committed to operator training with a dedicated page and it extends its established offer, so escalation of commitment leads management to persist despite any weak results.
Although only mentioned briefly, the fourth rotary axis accessory builds on the established offer, so its fit and sunk investment make a drop less likely.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's established offer and had only a brief website mention, leaving lower visible commitment and making it easier to abandon if results disappoint.

The high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the core business, highly visible with its own page, and central to the firm's announced direction, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
The automatic tool change system has a dedicated page and builds on the established offer, aligning with the firm's efficiency focus, so the firm is likely to persist with it.
